description: FIND-016 NOT CLOSED. lib/menu.py:15-18 _BUDGET_RANK STILL has the defensive double-key set (Budget.FULL: 4 AND "FULL": 4 simultaneously). No comment was added to document this is intentional; no enforcement was added to require Budget enum only. Future regression where a caller passes a string and the enum import drifts would still be silently masked.
